gloss: to accept a loss silently; to give up without protest

definitions.gloss: to accept a loss silently; to give up without protest; to swallow one's grievance
definitions.explanation: To resign oneself to an unfair situation without taking action or complaining, usually because one feels powerless to change it.

examples.japanese: {泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}りするしかなかった。
examples.english: I had no choice but to accept it silently.
Many people who suffer harm just accept it without protest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}った→遭う：09500_au⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}り→泣き寝入り：13304_nakineiri⟧せず、⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}けた→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: If you've been scammed, rather than giving up silently, you should report it to the police.

notes:
⟦{泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}り→泣き寝入り：13304_nakineiri⟧ literally means "crying oneself to sleep" (⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧ + {寝入|ねい}る), evoking the image of someone who can only cry and then fall asleep without resolving their problem. The expression conveys resignation in the face of injustice or mistreatment.

USAGE:
Used both as a noun (⟦{泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}り→泣き寝入り：13304_nakineiri⟧) and as a suru verb. Often appears with ⟦しかない→〜しかない：30533_shikanai⟧ (have no choice but to) or せず (without doing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}りする⟦しかない→〜しかない：30533_shikanai⟧: have no choice but to accept it
- {泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}りせず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: without giving up quietly
- {泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}りさせない: not let someone be taken advantage of silently
- ⟦{消費者|しょうひしゃ}→消費者：09866_shouhisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}り→泣き寝入り：13304_nakineiri⟧: consumers quietly accepting unfair treatment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{諦|あきら}める→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧: to give up — more neutral; can be used for positive acceptance too
- ⟦{我慢|がまん}する→我慢する：25343_gamansuru⟧: to endure; to put up with — emphasizes patience and endurance rather than resigned defeat
- {泣|な}く{泣|な}く: reluctantly; tearfully — an adverb describing doing something unwillingly
